step1_analysis.circuit_type: CML Buffer with Pre-emphasis / Phase Detector
step1_analysis.description: A differential Current Mode Logic (CML) buffer with two input pairs sharing the same active PMOS loads. It is typically used as a pre-emphasis buffer by driving the second pair with delayed data, or as a phase detector/mixer in a PLL/DLL.

paper_reference.title: A 2.5–3.125-Gb/s Quad Transceiver With Second-Order Analog DLL-Based CDRs

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the buffer stage

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail = 0.5 * un*Cox * (W/L) * (VB - Vth)^2 = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.54 - 0.42)^2 = 19.4 uA. Total current for two tails = 38.8 uA. Power = 38.8 uA * 1.8 V = 70 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters at 1.8V supply. The paper's 32 mW is for the entire quad transceiver, so this single block's power is much lower.

v_swing_diff.description: Maximum peak-to-peak differential output voltage swing

sky130_expected.calculation: PMOS linear resistance R = 1 / (up*Cox * (W/L) * (VDD - VCM - |Vth|)) = 1 / (50u * 10 * (1.8 - 0.9 - 0.42)) = 4.16 kOhm. Max single-ended swing = (I_tail1 + I_tail2) * R = 38.8 uA * 4.16 kOhm = 161 mV. Differential swing = 2 * 161 mV = 322 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The PMOS transistors act as active loads in the linear region. The swing depends on the total steered tail current and the PMOS resistance.
The PMOS loads pull the output close to VDD, with the DC drop determined by the average tail current.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, output common-mode voltage, and differential voltage swing under dynamic switching conditions.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML Buffer with Pre-emphasis Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 VT1 VB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VT2 VB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUTM DNB VT2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUTP DN VT2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUTP UPB VT1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUTM UP VT1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 OUTP VCM VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 OUTM VCM VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB VB 0 0.54
VVCM VCM 0 0.9

* Inputs: UP/UPB (Main Data) and DN/DNB (Delayed Data for Pre-emphasis)
VUP UP 0 PULSE(0.6 1.2 1n 50p 50p 2n 4n)
VUPB UPB 0 PULSE(1.2 0.6 1n 50p 50p 2n 4n)
VDN DN 0 PULSE(0.6 1.2 2n 50p 50p 4n 8n)
VDNB DNB 0 PULSE(1.2 0.6 2n 50p 50p 4n 8n)

* Parasitic Load Capacitance
C1 OUTP 0 10f
C2 OUTM 0 10f

.control
  * DC Operating Point for Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * Transient Analysis for Swing and Delay
  tran 10p 10n
  
  * Calculate Differential Output
  let vdiff = v(OUTP) - v(OUTM)
  
  * Measure Differential Swing
  meas tran vdiff_max max vdiff
  meas tran vdiff_min min vdiff
  let swing_diff = vdiff_max - vdiff_min
  print swing_diff
  
  * Measure Single-Ended Swings and Common Mode
  meas tran voutp_max max v(OUTP)
  meas tran voutp_min min v(OUTP)
  let voutp_cm = (voutp_max + voutp_min) / 2
  print voutp_cm

  quit
.endc
.end
